episode_equation: episode = ordered sequence of step_transition rows
forbidden_input_fields: target_suffix_choice visible as a label token in state_t
purpose: Represent decoder/denoise repair as ordered maintainer episode steps instead of flat mixed repair rows.

required_fields.action_t: Typed action taken or proposed at the step.
required_fields.active_generation_prefix_span: Bounded prefix shown to the decoder/denoiser.
required_fields.decoder_target: Bounded target text for authorized denoise or future gated decode.
required_fields.episode_id: Opaque id for a full maintenance attempt or synthetic repair trajectory.
required_fields.loss_mask: Per-loss authorization card. Decoder CE remains false until separately authorized.
required_fields.observation_t: Tool/verifier/model observation used by the repair step.
required_fields.reward_or_verifier: Verifier-derived signal: pass/fail/failure type/confidence, not hidden scoring.
required_fields.state_t: Structured state before the step; no target labels or hidden authority.
required_fields.state_t_plus_1: Clean next state or repaired state target.
required_fields.step_id: Opaque row-local step id within the episode.
required_fields.step_index: Integer transition index in the episode.
required_fields.target_suffix_choice: Route-local continuation class for suffix/token repair.
